auth.passwordRules: At least 12 characters, with upper and lower case and a digit.

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.

home.emptyBody: If you have an active plan, today's session shows up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.previewBody: This is not a mockup — the whole app repaints as you choose.

cues.title: Sound and vibration
cues.speechHint: A synthetic voice announces the round and the rest. Turning it off keeps the beep and the vibration.
cues.toneHint: A short tone for the 3-2-1 countdown and every phase change. On iPhone this is the only audible cue.
cues.hapticsHint: A buzz when a set is checked, on a record, and at every round change.

library.emptyBody: Try a different search term or filter.

admin.title: Overview
admin.queueEmptyBody: Every submitted exercise has been decided.
admin.forbiddenBody: This page is available to administrators only.
admin.footer: {{sessions}} active sessions · {{events}} audit events in the last 24 hours

marketplace.title: Marketplace reports
marketplace.emptyBody: When somebody reports a post or a profile, it appears here.
marketplace.snapshot: The text as it was when reported
marketplace.snapshotTruncated: The text was longer; the copy is truncated.
marketplace.removalReasonHint: This goes into the audit log. The author does not see it.

coaching.title: My clients
coaching.forbiddenBody: Ask for an invite if you want to coach here.
coaching.handoverBody: You still know the password for these, so the client cannot use the app until they set their own.
coaching.joinCodesBody: The code is stored hashed — you see the plaintext once, at creation. It cannot be retrieved afterwards.
coaching.codeOnce: Copy it now. This is the only time you will see it — the server keeps only its hash.
coaching.pregenBody: The client gets a temporary password from you. Until they set their own, the account can do nothing in the app — so you are not left holding access.
coaching.tempOnce: Write these temporary passwords down now — they are not stored in plaintext.
coaching.emptyBody: Hand out a join code, or create accounts for them.
coaching.archiveConfirmBody: {{email}} will leave your roster and you will not see their future data. This is reversible, but access ends immediately.
coaching.profileDraft: Not finished yet — do not build a plan on partial answers.
coaching.noProfile: This client has not filled in the questionnaire yet.
coaching.clientMissingBody: Either they are not yours, or the link was archived.
coaching.noHistoryBody: It appears here as soon as the client finishes a session.

nutrition.emptyBody: Build one for this client. While it is a draft they cannot see it.
nutrition.draftNote: This plan is still a draft — the client cannot see it until you activate it.

onboarding.saveError: Save failed — your answer is kept and will be retried
onboarding.experience: How much training experience do you have?
onboarding.sessionMinutesHint: Roughly — it sets how much fits in a session.
onboarding.equipmentHint: Only tick what you can actually reach. Your plan is built from it.
onboarding.bodyOptional: This part is optional. Everything works without it — load estimates are just rougher.
onboarding.sexHint: Asked because strength norms and 1RM estimates differ. You can skip it.
onboarding.limitationsHint: Anything that needs care? Mark it — your coach will see it and the plan avoids it.
onboarding.notesHint: In your own words. Your coach reads exactly this.

goal.title: What are you after?
goal.body: Pick one main goal — the whole plan is built on it.

schedule.title: How much can you train?
schedule.body: The honest number is the right one. It sets the volume.

equipment.title: Where and with what?
equipment.body: You will only be given exercises you can actually do.

body.title: A few details about you
body.body: These help estimate loads and track progress.

limitations.title: Any injuries or limits?
limitations.body: What you put here is respected by the plan and seen by your coach.

goalHint.strength: Heavy loads, low reps, long rests.
goalHint.fat-loss: Strength work that keeps muscle, at a denser pace.
goalHint.health: General fitness at a load you can sustain.

workout.noneBody: Start today's session, or do a freestyle workout.

interval.title: Interval
interval.interruptedBody: The phone suspended the app for {{count}} round(s). They were not recorded.
interval.notConfigured: This block has no prescribed durations
interval.blockTooLong: This block has too many rounds (50 max)

plans.title: Workout plans
plans.newHint: Created as a template; assign it to a client from their page.
plans.emptyBody: Build a template once, then hand it to any client.
plans.missingBody: Either it is not yours, or it was archived.
plans.noDaysBody: Add a day, then put blocks and exercises in it.
plans.cycleFull: Every day of the {{days}}-day cycle is taken.
plans.needsStart: Activating needs a start date — without one the client’s home screen stays empty.
plans.cloneHint: A deep copy is made. The two plans are independent from then on — editing one does not touch the other.
plans.cycleGrew: The cycle grew to {{days}} days — every future occurrence has shifted with it.
plans.noneForClient: This client has no plan yet
plans.noneForClientBody: Create one, or clone a template onto them.

progress.heading: Progress
progress.notEnough: Not enough data to chart yet ({{count}} day(s)). Three training days are needed — two points are not a trend.
progress.title: Progress
progress.emptyBody: Record at least three and the trend appears.
progress.outOfRange: That value is outside the plausible range. Check for a typo.
progress.photoPrivacyNote: By default NOBODY can see your photos — not even your coach, until you say so.
progress.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Only JPEG, PNG or WebP images are accepted.
progress.noPhotosBody: Comparing needs at least two, in the same pose.
progress.sharingNote: Measurements and photos are separate decisions. Revoking takes effect immediately.

chat.emptyBody: Write the first one — the other person gets a notification.
chat.sendFailed: The message could not be sent. Your text is still here.
chat.unavailable: This conversation is no longer available.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Messages and plan changes show up here.

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.emptyBody: Search for a food and add it to the day.
nutrition.noTargetToday: No target for this date — the plan cycle does not land here.

coins.title: Coins
coins.storeEmptyBody: Nothing is for sale right now.
coins.purchaseRefused: That purchase did not go through. Check your balance — the price may have changed.
coins.alreadyProcessed: That purchase had already gone through. You were not charged again.
coins.awardedNote: These are awarded automatically when you earn them — there is nothing to collect.
coins.noHistoryBody: Coins appear here as you earn and spend them.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.emptyBody: As coaches publish programmes and events, they will appear here.
marketplace.noResultsBody: Try different words, or clear the city filter.
marketplace.searchCapped: Search returns one page of results. Narrow it by words or by city if this is not what you were after.
marketplace.postGoneBody: It may have moved, or its author may have taken it down. The marketplace is still there to browse.
marketplace.coachGoneBody: It may not be published yet, or it may no longer be available.
marketplace.priceNote: The price is for information. Signing up happens with the coach directly — payment does not go through the app yet.

compose.title: Marketplace desk
compose.subtitle: Everything that reaches the public marketplace starts here.
compose.removedBody: A moderator removed your public profile. Your posts are not on the marketplace.
compose.guidelinesBody: You need to accept the guidelines now in force before publishing.
compose.noProfileTitle: You have no public profile yet
compose.noProfileBody: Your posts sit on a profile. This is the first step.
compose.noPostsBody: Write a draft — it only goes public when you say so.
compose.postGoneBody: You may have deleted it, or it never existed.
compose.postRemoved: A moderator removed this post. It is read-only.
compose.kindFrozen: The type cannot be changed after creation.
compose.handleHint: 3–32 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Changing it later is a separate request.
compose.headline: Headline
compose.needsEventTime: This type also needs an event time.
compose.previewEmpty: Write something and it will appear here as others will see it.
compose.restoreKeepsPosition: Restoring returns it to its original position and spends no daily slot.
compose.staleServerCopy: You saved elsewhere in the meantime. The server holds this:
compose.limitsNote: Title up to {{title}}, text up to {{body}} characters.

reason.generic: That cannot be done right now.
reason.too_new: The account is still new. You can publish after {{when}}.
reason.quota_reached: No slots left today ({{used}}/{{max}}). Next one: {{next}}.
reason.kind_shape: The {{field}} field does not fit this type.
reason.key_reused: That request was already sent with different content.
reason.stale: This post changed in the meantime.
reason.withdrawn: This post is taken down. Restore it first.
reason.session_stale: The session is stale. Sign in again.
reason.handle_changed: Your profile name changed in the meantime — it is now {{handle}}. Reload before trying again.
reason.rename_too_soon: You changed this name recently. The next change is possible after {{date}}.

markdown.too_long: The text is longer than allowed.
markdown.no_visible_text: The text has no visible content.
markdown.malformed_text: The text contains a malformed character.

compose.coverReplaceNote: To change it: remove this one first, then upload another.
compose.coverAltHint: What does the image show? This is what someone who cannot see it will hear.
compose.coverFailed: The image could not be uploaded.
compose.handleMalformed: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only, 3–32 characters.
compose.handleUnknown: Could not check just now — saving will tell you.
compose.handleCooldownWarning: You are letting {{handle}} go, and nobody else can take it for {{retireDays}} days. You will be able to change it again in {{days}} days.

studio.title: Element style studio
studio.intro: Every element against its five variants, with the real component. What you pick here applies to every user on their next load — no code change, no redeploy.
studio.failed: The change did not go through. Reload to see where things actually stand.
studio.noPreview: No live preview for this element on this screen yet. The variant is still real — components read it.
studio.inertExplain: No component reads this setting today. It would save and it would be audited, and the product would not change by a pixel — so the switch stays disabled until something consumes it.
studio.loadFailedBody: The server did not answer. Reload the page.
